messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
My dad saved my life when I was 9.

output.original_text: My dad saved my life when I was 9.
output.joy: My incredible dad saved my life when I was just 9!
output.sadness: My dad saved my life when I was 9, and I still feel the weight of that moment.
output.fear: I can’t believe my dad saved my life when I was just 9; it’s terrifying to think what could have happened otherwise.
output.anger: It infuriates me that my dad had to save my life when I was only 9!
output.surprise: You won’t believe it, but my dad actually saved my life when I was 9!
output.disgust: It’s sickening to think that my dad had to save my life when I was just 9.
